exposure: Future intention to use health facility
outcome: Factors associated with disrespect and abuse during childbirth
cohort: 284 postpartum women in Bahir Dar town, Ethiopia
finding: The study found a high prevalence of disrespect and abuse during facility childbirth in Bahir Dar town, Ethiopia, particularly among women from rural areas, those who experienced complications during delivery, and those who gave birth via caesarean section.
mod_finding: Women who had a caesarean birth were more likely to experience disrespect and abuse.
